construction_notes: Minimally vaccinated = (1) one documented seasonal influenza (tri- or quadrivalent) vaccine within the last year to the end of follow-up (death or chart review, whichever came first), PLUS (2) a 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine (PPV23) no more than five years old and/or a 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV13) given at any time
COVID-19 vaccination is deliberately excluded from the minimally-vaccinated definition because mRNA COVID-19 vaccines were available only after December 27, 2020

Cumulative incidence of vaccination estimated with the Aalen-Johansen estimator with death as a competing risk; Gray's test used to check for statistical differences; no competing risk considered in the before-diagnosis sub-analysis
Cumulative incidence ratio (CIR) formed by dividing the two cumulative incidences; its 95 % CI from standard error approximations for proportions

Incidence rates reported as vaccination events per 1000 person-months of follow-up (PMFU); 95 % CI by Byar's approximation to the Poisson distribution; incidence rate ratios compare the rates at 6 and 12 months

Patients vaccinated against pneumococcal disease six years before an HNC diagnosis are excluded from calculations of post-diagnosis uptake (Danish guidelines do not recommend annual pneumococcal vaccination)

Comorbidities identified from patients' medical history by chart review at the time of cancer diagnosis using ICD-10 codes (19 conditions listed); the Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) calculated from them
HNC identified by ICD-10 codes C.01.9-C.13, C.30-C.32, and C.77
Proportions reported as percentages and continuous data as medians with interquartile ranges; Mann-Whitney U test for continuous and Fisher's exact test for categorical comparisons
All analyses in R version 4.2.2; a p-value <= 0.05 considered statistically significant
Post hoc power calculations are said to confirm that the study had sufficient power to derive estimates within a 99 % confidence interval
